digest.component_or_area: LLM provider layer — Bedrock first-class support
propositions: rebar must construct a native BedrockConverseModel through pydantic-ai without an OpenAI-compatible gateway, authenticating via ambient AWS credential chain (instance role or AWS_PROFILE)

prompt caching on Bedrock requires exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, and bedrock_cache_messages must be rejected

rebar must warn (not block) when caching was requested but both cache_read and cache_write counters are zero while input_tokens > 0, since Bedrock silently fails to cache on some models and bills full input every call

the temperature sampling parameter is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models like us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7, and because pydantic-ai only drops unsupported sampling parameters on the Anthropic path (not Bedrock), rebar must gate temperature via a supports_temperature capability withdrawn for affected model ids

a provider-agnostic error translator in src/rebar/llm/failure.py must catch 400 errors mentioning a sampling parameter and a rejection word, converting them to LLMConfigError with remedies, without introducing provider-name branches

the bedrock builder must live in a separate module (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py) because providers.py is at its 300-LOC attested capacity, and boto3 must remain out of the default [agents] install via a [bedrock] optional extra that dev installs to make tests real
